title: Lineum Licensing & Legal Framework
summary: Knowledge Item for the dual-licensing structure (AGPLv3 and Commercial) and copyright facts for the Lineum project. Consolidates the authorship audit, DCO/CLA requirements, and directory-specific license invariants (AGPLv3 for code, CC-BY-4.0 for whitepapers). It validates Tomáš Tříska as sole author and documents the trademark protection of 'Lineum™', 'Lina™', and the official 'Happy Accident' logo symbol.
